Step 9: Conclude \( b = 1 \).

Step 12: Use the relationship \( (2i)! = (2i)!! \cdot (2i-1)!! = 2^i \cdot i! \cdot (2i-1)!! \) and find \( p((2i)!) \).

Step 13: Calculate \( p\left( {2i\choose i} \right) = p((2i)!) - 2p(i!) = i - p(i!) \).

Step 15: Conclude that \( f(i) = 2\cdot 2009 - i - p(i!) \) is a strictly decreasing function.

Step 16: Therefore, \( p(c) = p\left( {2\cdot 2009\choose 2009} \right) = 2009 - p(2009!) \).

Step 17: Compute \( p(2009!) = \sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \left\lfloor \frac{2009}{2^k} \right\rfloor = 1004 + 502 + \cdots + 3 + 1 = 2001 \).

Step 18: Thus, \( p(c) = 2009 - 2001 = 8 \).

Step 19: Find \( a = 2\cdot 2009 - p(c) = 4010 \).

Step 20: Compute \( \frac{ab}{10} = \frac{4010 \cdot 1}{10} = 401 \).

Final answer: \(\boxed{401}\)
